decisions.statement: A row is read here because no agent can read a line that long.
A page already filed is left as it is, so a second run writes nothing.
The rows a game holds are left where they are rather than taken away.
A row read from the last file named wins where two rows are one page.
No call says which of a game's files to read.

definition: the command taking a game's rows into the pages of that game's world
